text:
stacey-csm: FYI — CustCap sent back their SIG. They claim during our key rotation they hit 401s and several audit-log entries are missing. They want repro steps + HSM attestation by EOD Mon. Can support + security help triage? :eyes:

devin-support: Looking now. Do we have the rotation job run id and any request ids from their report?

stacey-csm: They attached two request ids: rcpt-9a2f and rcpt-9a2g, and included the API call time window (2026-03-15 22:02–22:08 UTC).

infra-alert: rotation-job finished: key=custcap-prod-01 rotation_id=rot-20260315-22-02 status=success 

omar-secu: Quick questions: 1) Was this a PKCS#11 HSM rotation or a software-keystore rotation? 2) Did we update the key thumbprint in the auth service in the same deployment window? Need those before we dig into 401 traces.

jules-eng: We performed a two-step rotation: staged KMS (internal keystore) rotate -> rolling restart of auth-service -> finalize rotation in KMS. No HSM slot change — HSM kept the same wrapping key. Auth thumbprint update was part of the rolling deploy at 22:03 UTC.

devin-support: Reproduced locally against staging with the customer's headers. Quick repro:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-custcap-temp" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: rcpt-9a2f" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_signature","meta":{"service":"auth-service","thumbprint":"old-thumbprint"}}

jules-eng: Server logs show an auth-service instance still validating against old-thumbprint for ~120s after rotation finalize. Snippet: `auth-service[pid=2345] WARN key_mismatch: expected=new-thumbprint got=old-thumbprint request=rcpt-9a2f`

omar-secu: That lines up. If auth-service validated against old thumbprint some replicas may have been behind, which explains intermittent 401s. But what about the missing audit entries? The SIG asks for proof of rotation in audit logs.

devin-support: Checking audit pipeline: rotation event emitted to audit.log at 2026-03-15T22:02:13Z with rotation_id=rot-20260315-22-02, but I see a downstream consumer (audit-collector) retrying failed writes between 22:02:30–22:04:10 — likely due to a transient DB failover. Those retries may have been dropped from the export bundle the customer received.

sre-maya: Confirmed — there was a short window of PG primary failover at 22:03:05 UTC. audit-collector retried but some batches exceeded retention TTL in the collector buffer and were evicted. We still have raw S3 shards for that window: s3://redwood-logs/custcap/2026/03/15/22/ (preserve).

ak-sales: Customer flagged a billing spike from 22:02–22:10 due to client retrying on 401s. They asked for credits. Suggest provisional credit for that window and we'll reconcile after we confirm request volumes. :thinking_face:

stacey-csm: Good call. Can eng/security confirm scope and provide exact request counts so I can propose credits?

devin-support: I'll pull counts for rcpt-9a2f/g plus any other request-ids in that account during 22:00–22:12 UTC and post numbers here by EOD PST.

omar-secu: For the SIG, customer needs: 1) HSM attestation (we didn't touch HSM slot but provide docs), 2) rotation audit trail (we can provide rotation event + raw S3 shards), 3) description of root cause (replica race + collector failover) and mitigation. I'll draft language.

jules-eng: Mitigation: tighten thumbprint rollout ordering (atomic config push) and increase audit-collector buffer TTL for rotation windows. Also add a post-rotate health check that queries all auth replicas for current-thumbprint before finalizing. I'll open a tracking ticket.

devin-support: Repro steps for support team (staging):
1) set customer key to pre-rotate thumbprint in keystore
2) trigger rotation job rot-20260315-22-02 in staging
3) run curl with X-Request-ID from customer
4) tail auth-service logs and audit-collector logs (paths below)

Log locations:
- auth-service: /var/log/auth-service/auth.log*
- audit-collector: /var/log/audit-collector/collector.log*
- raw exports: s3://redwood-logs/custcap/2026/03/15/22/

sre-maya: Preserving S3 shards and snapshots. Do NOT run log rotations on those prefixes until legal/secu signoff.

stacey-csm: I'll inform the customer staging repro steps + that we preserved raw logs and will provide a draft attestation + root-cause write-up tomorrow morning. Asking for EOD Mon final deliverable — is that still realistic?

omar-secu: EOD Mon is tight but doable if eng + support provide counts and preserved logs today and I finalize attestation draft tonight. I'll ping security counsel if we need an SCCE signature.

ak-sales: I'll tentatively offer a 25% credit on the spike window and escalate to finance for approval; hold final until we have exact token counts.

stacey-csm: Owners: devin-support (repro + request counts), jules-eng (fix ticket + thumbprint gating), sre-maya (preserve logs), omar-secu (attestation + RCA). I'll follow up with the customer after we have numbers. :white_check_mark:

devin-support: On it — posting counts + raw logs link by 18:00 PST.

jules-eng: Opening ticket INF-8342 for the rollout ordering guard and post-rotate health-check.

omar-secu: Drafting attestation now, will share for review.

stacey-csm: Thanks team. Keeping thread pinned to the CSM channel and I'll update the SIG tracker once we have artifacts. :pray:
